title: Miracles in the River: Receiving the Power of God
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner takes you on a journey of spiritual awakening and miracles, as he prays for healing and deliverance in the presence of God's anointing. Listen as the congregation experiences breakthroughs and testimonies of God's power and presence, and be inspired to receive your own miracle. Don't miss this energetic and faith-filled message that will leave you in awe of God's mighty works.
